source.title: Changes in the Board of Directors (November 2019)
source.content:
With the terms of Board Members Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol and Bob Burton coming to an end, an anonymous election took place on November 9th, 2019. The election was done according to the [WCA Motion: Election of Directors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2019.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf). 

The Board received the applications of:

* Bob Burton
* Henrik Buus Aagaard

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that both **Bob Burton** and **Henrik Buus Aagaard** were respectively re-elected and elected members of the WCA Board of Directors.

We want to thank Alberto for all the things he has done for the WCA. We wish him all the best in his future activities!

These changes have become effective immediately.

Henrik’s and Bob’s applications can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JmWkPLKYqDqBdLx0NSW5DGySq_kLVLd6?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2019 年 11 月）
translation.content:
Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol 和 Bob Burton 的董事任期即将结束，WCA 于 2019 年 11 月 9 日举行了不记名选举。此次选举依据[《WCA 董事选举动议》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2019.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)进行。

董事会收到以下两人的申请：

* Bob Burton
* Henrik Buus Aagaard

我们很高兴地宣布，选举顺利完成，**Bob Burton** 成功连任，**Henrik Buus Aagaard** 新当选为 WCA 董事会成员。

感谢 Alberto 为 WCA 所做的一切，祝他今后一切顺利！

上述变动已立即生效。

Henrik 和 Bob 的申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JmWkPLKYqDqBdLx0NSW5DGySq_kLVLd6?usp=sharing)查看。
